metadata.name: O’Connell and Langdon entrance links to campus-feet outdoor graph
metadata.provenance: O’Connell uses three matched AO doorway endpoints. Langdon connects its loading-dock approach and all three existing gates through the user-confirmed walkable courtyard.
metadata.accessibility: Unknown; no true flag is inferred from a nearby AO doorway.
metadata.review: Registration residuals and precise approach geometry remain approximate. Gate/courtyard walkability is user-confirmed. No proximity search creates these links.

walkabilityConfirmation.statement: The entire section between the gates in Langdon and the O’Connell doors used in the test is walkable; the gates can safely connect to the outdoor graph.
walkabilityConfirmation.geometry: Three approach points five global feet outside the existing gate midpoints, connected parallel to the fence. The west approach joins existing courtyard OSM node 12217284216; the east approach joins existing O’Connell exterior approach OSM node 5862340697. These paths stay in the confirmed open area; only gate edges cross the fence.
walkabilityConfirmation.accessibility: General walkability only; no accessible-route or ramp-compliance assertion.
